nodes.name: Slack: tell @lena why it is held
Write welcome + first week (model)

messageValues.message:
You write onboarding messages for Fernhill Software (makers of Fernhill Dispatch, scheduling software for HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors). Fully remote company.
You get a JSON summary of an APPROVED access plan. Write:
1. welcome_message: a warm, specific welcome email to the new hire (80-140 words). Mention their start date, work email, the Slack channels they will be in, and that their laptop ships before day one.
2. first_week_plan: 5 short items (Day 1..Day 5) the manager can run, fitting the role.
Rules: mention ONLY the Slack channels listed in the plan. Never mention admin rights, production access, pay, equity or benefits amounts. Never promise access that is not in the plan. Plain text, no markdown headings.

nodes.notes: The model sees the plan summary only: never the manager notes, never the matrix.

nodes.name: Slack: ask @lena to approve

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: '@lena', text: 'Approve onboarding for ' + $json.plan.name + ' (' + $json.plan.title + ', starts ' + $json.plan.start_date + ')? Groups: ' + $json.plan.google.groups.join(', ') + '. Channels: ' + $json.plan.slack.channels.join(', ') + ($json.plan.privileged.length ? '. PRIVILEGED (needs @sam too): ' + $json.plan.privileged.join(', ') : '') + ($json.notes_for_approver ? '. Manager notes (NOT applied): ' + $json.notes_for_approver : '') }) }}

nodes.notes: Live: Slack "Send and wait for response" to @lena replaces this post + the Wait node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: '@sam', text: '@lena approved ' + $json.plan.name + '. Also grant PRIVILEGED access: ' + $json.plan.privileged.join(', ') + '? Reject = everything else is still created, minus these.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: '@lena', text: 'Onboarding for ' + $json.email + ' not approved (' + $json.reason + '). Nothing was created.' }) }}
